page.overview:
Who is Gram?

Gram was born in TA 2668 to his father, King Déor, and his unnamed wife. Gram became king at the age of fifty when Déor died in TA 2718. His reign was one of war with the Dunlendings, who continued to raid Rohan from the fortress of Isengard which they controlled. He died in TA 2741 at the age of seventy-three, after twenty-three years of open warfare, and was succeeded by his son Helm Hammerhand, who continued the struggle.
